title: Is Riftn the Same as DeHub? What Changed and What Did Not
html:
Yes. Riftn is the new name of DeHub. It is the same open source, user-owned social network, built by the same team since 2021. The name and the web address changed in November 2026. Your account, your posts and your followers did not.

What changed

  • The name. DeHub is now Riftn.
  • The address. dehub.io is now riftn.com. Old links forward to the same page on the new address.
  • The token. $RIFT is Riftn's token. If you hold DHB, your balance comes with you, and you log in once to claim it after listing.

What stayed the same

  • Your account. Sign in the way you always have.
  • Your posts, followers, messages and wallet. Nothing was reset or removed.
  • The apps. Riftn is on the web, on Google Play and on the App Store.
  • The code. It is still open source.

Why did DeHub change its name?

The new name was put to the community in October 2026 as part of the relaunch plan. The full reasoning is in DeHub's next chapter.

Is dehub.io still safe to use?

Yes. dehub.io still belongs to us and forwards to riftn.com. Before you sign in anywhere, check that the address bar says riftn.com.

Is Riftn related to DePaul's DeHUB or Rowan's DEHub?

No. Those are university services that happened to share our old name. Riftn has no connection to either of them.

Where to start

New here? Read What is Riftn?, or open riftn.com and look around. You can browse without an account.
